description.value:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet fails a Will save

Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched

You spend 1 Bandwidth. The triggering ally is unaffected by that effect, and you suffer it instead, using the ally's degree of failure — you do not attempt your own save. If the effect could not affect you at all, the Bandwidth is still spent and the ally is still unaffected.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reaction, cost 1 Bandwidth: trigger is an ally's failed Will save; the ally is unaffected and the holder suffers it instead, at the ally's degree of failure. Redirecting a different creature's already-resolving save-effect onto yourself, at their degree of failure, is exactly the cross-creature shape with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source, plus a real Bandwidth cost. A standing effect from the holder's own passive altering a different creature's roll/HP/condition outside the normal one-time strike/spell pipeline has no selector anywhere in pf2e-source -- confirmed against `pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/sense.ts` (self-only) and the `iwr/` directory (Resistance/Weakness/Immunity are self-only); nothing grants/redirects an effect onto another actor's own standing rules outside a `GrantItem`/`Aura` companion-effect hand-off. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
